extDescription.message: Fixes janky YouTube Shorts scrolling in Chromium browsers. One wheel gesture lands on exactly one video.
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the browser

modeStepHint.message: Every wheel gesture lands on exactly one video. Never skips.

modeFlowHint.message: Glides while the gesture lasts, then aligns to the nearest video.

modeJumpHint.message: Cuts straight to the next video in a single frame, like the arrow keys.

hint.message: Changes apply to open Shorts tabs instantly. If it gets stuck, reload the tab with Ctrl+R.
